events.speaker: SABLE
events.text: That rope won't hold him and grabbing at his head will get your jaw broke. Give me room. One horse at a time, and nobody chases a thing.

events.speaker: SABLE
events.text: All of them in, and not one leg pulled up short doing it. That gelding will let a rope near him again by next week. Jonas can have the others back. That one's mine to finish.

events.speaker: SABLE
events.text: You rode drag and turned them to me instead of running them down yourself. I'll stay on. Don't put a hand on my string without asking first, and we'll get on fine.

events.speaker: SABLE
events.text: I judge a man by whether a green horse minds him being close by. You walked right past that gelding and he did not so much as lift his head. I've got no higher word than that in me.
